entities.name: John Joseph Lynch
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: John Joseph Lynch was an Irish Catholic prelate who served as the third Bishop (1860–1870) and first Archbishop of Toronto (1870–1888). He founded Our Lady of Angels Seminary in 1856. He was a member of the Vincentians.
